'''Aggression Management''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] guild that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
